title: NL Scholarship
about: Utrecht University's NL Scholarship supports non-EU/EEA students starting an international master's programme on 1 September 2027. The deadline is 1 February, 23:59 CET; selection starts only after the deadline. Not all programmes participate.
requirements: Non-EU/EEA students starting a master's at Utrecht University
Must have applied for an international master's programme starting 1 September 2027
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the NL Scholarship at Utrecht University, Utrecht, Netherlands, deadline 1 Feb 2027. The photo shows gabled canal houses and houseboats in Amsterdam, not Utrecht.
